description: A prepared animal skin used for leaves and bindings of older books. It cockles when exposed to damp and must be dried slowly under restraint to lie flat again.
name: vellum

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter III, p.53. Internet Archive.
